name: a fresh client gets all of a short history
a client holding line 0 starts at line 1
a caught-up client starts at committed
a client ahead of the server starts after its boundary
an absent replayMax is the server ceiling
a smaller replayMax raises the start
a replayMax above the ceiling is the ceiling
a boundary inside the bound wins over the clamp
history trimmed past the boundary starts at the oldest line
a fresh client of a trimmed deep ring gets the newest replayMax lines
committed below the bound leaves the start alone
committed equal to the bound leaves the start alone
